questionText:

Timeline of 1857: (B) The mutiny broke out at Meerut on 10 May 1857; (C) Meerut sepoys crossed the Yamuna and the Delhi garrison joined the revolt on 11-12 May; (A) Over May and June, the military mutiny developed into a widespread popular civilian revolt across the countryside; (D) In September 1857, British forces under Henry Havelock and James Outram fought their way into the Lucknow Residency. Sequence: (B), (C), (A), (D).
